There are always many people at the train station. The weather was sunny that day. It takes twenty minutes to get to the bus stop by bike. The parking meter ate my coins.
Jack is interested in singing. Max wrote about the day in the diary. The bus stop is one of the best places in the city. What's more, it's my pleasure to help you.
Max usually has soup for breakfast. Max hopes to visit Tokyo one day. Max likes sunny days best. What's more, could we have the bill, please?
Max and Jack had great fun there. Jack's birthday is in January. Life is full of small surprises.
